verdict.rationale: Intel's own oneAPI/oneDNN and PyTorch optimizations explicitly target Core Ultra Series 2 CPUs and Arc GPUs, and VTune profiler supports GPU/NPU analysis, showing vendor-stack support. However, there's no evidence of llama.cpp, MLX, or ONNX Runtime explicitly documenting support for this chip's CPU/GPU/NPU. Missing for 10: llama.cpp/ONNX Runtime/MLX documentation citing this exact silicon, NPU-specific runtime support evidence, independent benchmarks confirming real-world local-AI usage.
